residuals.problem: generation_config participates in invocation identity and receipts but is not yet delivered to the runner through a canonical protocol, so the runtime cannot distinguish declared configuration from runner-visible configuration
append-only event refs make races visible, but there is no explicit per-invocation local lease preventing two processes from attempting the same external execution concurrently

new_blocking_invariants: runner stdin is a canonical JSON execution envelope containing exact task_packet object, exact generation_config object, invocation_id and protocol version
the exact runner-input envelope is content-addressed and bound in the receipt
receipt wording may establish DELIVERED_TO_RUNNER_PROTOCOL but may not claim the model/provider actually honored generation settings unless separately attested
at most one local process may hold the execution lease for one invocation id at a time
a live same-invocation local lease blocks a second execution attempt before the external command starts
a stale local lease may be reclaimed only after local process-liveness evidence says its recorded PID is not alive
local lease semantics are not described as distributed exactly-once execution
RUNNING history remains recovery-blocking even after a stale lease is reclaimed

known_answer_worlds.name: generation_config_delivered_in_runner_envelope
known_answer_worlds.expected: fake runner observes those exact values under execution envelope generation_config and receipt binds runner_input_sha256

known_answer_worlds.name: task_packet_preserved_inside_runner_envelope
known_answer_worlds.expected: runner sees the exact parsed task packet object and receipt packet_sha256 still identifies original task-packet bytes

known_answer_worlds.name: concurrent_same_invocation_executes_once_locally
known_answer_worlds.given: first runner holds lease while sleeping after incrementing a counter; second manager invocation starts while first is active
known_answer_worlds.expected: first eventually completes, second returns RECOVERY_REQUIRED/invocation_active_elsewhere, counter=1

known_answer_worlds.name: stale_lease_can_be_reclaimed_for_retry_safe_prepared_attempt
known_answer_worlds.given: PREPARED history plus lock with demonstrably dead PID and retry_safe=true
known_answer_worlds.expected: lease reclaimed and new attempt may execute

falsifiers: if a fake runner cannot observe the exact frozen generation config from its canonical input envelope, configuration binding is refuted
if two local concurrent callers execute the same external runner under the same invocation id, local duplicate-safe execution is refuted
if reclaiming a stale lease allows RUNNING history to auto-retry, recovery safety is refuted
if the receipt calls delivered settings model-applied without provider evidence, authority honesty is refuted
